name: Ibuki (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ibuki town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a smaller ring, surrounded by three triangles.
history: Flag of the former town of Ibuki in Shiga Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-02-14.

features.role: Ibuki town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a smaller ring, surrounded by three triangles
